confirmed_facts.text: Donald Trump is on a fresh collision course with Volodymyr Zelenskyy and European allies after his stunning agreement to buy Russian diesel upended years of US and western pressure on the Kremlin to end its war against Ukraine.

confirmed_facts.text: Zelenskyy reacted furiously to Trump’s announcement of the deal with Vladimir Putin on Friday, calling it “absolutely terrible” and “not fair and not honest”.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Zelenskyy reacted furiously to Trump’s announcement of the deal with Vladimir Putin on Friday, calling it “absolutely terrible” and “not fair and not honest”.

confirmed_facts.text: The Ukrainian president said “back room deals” with the Russian leader would give Putin more chances on the battlefield.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: The Ukrainian president said “back room deals” with the Russian leader would give Putin more chances on the battlefield.

confirmed_facts.text: On Saturday morning, Ukrainian officials reported that a Russian attack had killed 12 people in the south-east, including three children, and Moscow claimed its troops were advancing in the east.

items.title: Russian glide bomb attack on Zaporizhzhia kills at least 20 people
items.summary: Volodymyr Zelensky says the attack, which left children dead, was Russia expressing its "thanks" for a US diesel deal.
items.why_relevant: 俄袭乌克兰，与柴油交易联动

confirmed_facts.text: Russian glide bomb attack on Zaporizhzhia kills at least 20 people - Published Russia has attacked the Ukrainian city of Zaporizhzhia with five glide bombs, killing at least 20 people including four children, local officials said.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Russian glide bomb attack on Zaporizhzhia kills at least 20 people - Published Russia has attacked the Ukrainian city of Zaporizhzhia with five glide bombs, killing at least 20 people including four children, local officials said.

confirmed_facts.text: At least 32 others were injured in the attack, with more still missing and believed to be under the rubble.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: At least 32 others were injured in the attack, with more still missing and believed to be under the rubble.

confirmed_facts.text: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said the attacks on Zaporizhzhia were Russia expressing "its thanks" for a deal announced by US President Donald Trump last night easing sanctions on Moscow to import Russian diesel.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said the attacks on Zaporizhzhia were Russia expressing "its thanks" for a deal announced by US President Donald Trump last night easing sanctions on Moscow to import Russian diesel.

confirmed_facts.text: He added that 13 other regions had come under attack overnight, arguing this demonstrated Russia took "any easing of pressure to mean they can keep fighting".
confirmed_facts.excerpt: He added that 13 other regions had come under attack overnight, arguing this demonstrated Russia took "any easing of pressure to mean they can keep fighting".

confirmed_facts.text: Photos and videos from the site of one of the strikes in Zaporizhzhia show an apartment block mostly destroyed.
confirmed_facts.excerpt: Photos and videos from the site of one of the strikes in Zaporizhzhia show an apartment block mostly destroyed.

confirmed_facts.text: "The ground floor was hit, and the floors above just collapsed," acting Mayor Regina Harchenko told Ukrainian television from the scene.
